# kion_saml_group_association (Resource)

Manages a Kion Saml Group Association.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_saml_group_association" "example" {
  # Optional
  # assertion_name  = "example"
  # assertion_regex = "example"
  # idms_id         = 1
  # last_updated    = "example"
  # update_on_login = false
  # user_group_id   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assertion_name` (String) AssertionName of the assertion in saml.
- `assertion_regex` (String) Regular expression used to determine a match.
- `idms_id` (Number) ID of the idms the group association will apply to.
- `last_updated` (String) The last time this resource was updated.
- `update_on_login` (Boolean) If the group associations should be updated every time a user logs in.
- `user_group_id` (Number) ID of the user group this assertion will map to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group Association ID.
- `idms_saml_id` (Number) The ID of the SAML IDMS.
- `should_update_on_login` (Boolean) Whether the association updates on login.
